findings.explanation: The client has sole discretion over whether your work is complete and can demand an unlimited number of revisions, additions, or alterations without extra pay.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall review deliverables within a reasonable time, and the Contractor agrees to provide a reasonable number of revisions as specified in the Statement of Work.

findings.explanation: All intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation through work-made-for-hire and present assignment language, before you are paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. - In the relevant clause regarding work completeness, the agreement grants sole discretion over completion and unlimited revisions without extra pay, and I propose modifying it so that the Client shall review deliverables within a reasonable time, and the Contractor agrees to provide a reasonable number of revisions as specified in the Statement of Work. - In the relevant clause addressing intellectual property, all rights transfer immediately upon creation before payment is received, and I propose modifying it so that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client. Best regards.
